children.name: Property inspector
Carry out the inspection
Start
INS-INSP-01 Start on a card starts the inspection and opens the checklists @smoke
INS-INSP-04 the request is now InProgress on Home, with Continue and progress
Inspections screen
INS-INSP-02 each checklist shows its name and items finished out of total
INS-INSP-16 the checklist progress counts the recorded items
Pause and continue
INS-INSP-05 the in-progress card at the top of Home shows this inspection
INS-INSP-17 pause: Home shows the progress; Continue on Property Details goes back to the checklists
Checklist items
INS-INSP-06 Continue opens a checklist; every item starts Pending
Record an item
INS-INSP-07 the item shows Description, Photos and Status; the slider is off until the required fields are filled
INS-INSP-08 notes are capped at 250 characters
INS-INSP-12 Accept + slide records the item: "Inspection item updated successfully", status Accepted
INS-INSP-15 a recorded item can be changed: the slider then reads Save
Required fields
INS-INSP-09 a required description blocks the slide with "Description is mandatory for this item."
INS-INSP-11 required photos need at least 2: one photo keeps the slider off
Photos
INS-INSP-10 a photo can be added (count n/5) and removed after confirming Delete
Item statuses
INS-INSP-13 Alert with a note is recorded as Alert
INS-INSP-14 Reject with a note is recorded as Rejected
Submit the final verdict
Submit gate
INS-INSP-03 Submit stays greyed out while a checklist is incomplete
INS-INSP-18 recording every item enables Submit
Final verdict
INS-INSP-19 Final Verdict suggests Not Ready when an item was rejected; the other option can be picked
INS-INSP-20 Cancel closes the verdict without submitting; reopening starts from the suggestion
Remarks
INS-INSP-21 remarks are capped at 250 characters
Submit
INS-INSP-22 Submit sends the verdict: "Inspection submitted successfully", the request is Completed @smoke
After you submit
INS-INSP-23 Show Details shows the Final Verdict card with the remarks and no Submit
Correct an item
INS-INSP-24 a submitted item is read-only until Edit Details; Cancel discards the change
INS-INSP-25 Edit Details → Save Changes updates the item; the verdict stays
Working offline
Offline banner
INS-OFF-01 offline shows the orange bar "You’re offline — changes will sync when connected."
What works offline
INS-OFF-02 Home still lists the requests seen online
Before you go
INS-OFF-03 a request opened online opens offline
Accept offline
INS-OFF-04 accepting offline updates the card at once and says it will sync @mutating
Pending sync
INS-OFF-05 Profile shows the change(s) pending sync
Unsynced logout
INS-OFF-06 logging out with unsynced work warns first; Cancel keeps you signed in
When you reconnect
INS-OFF-07 back online the saved work syncs: pending count clears and the request stays Accepted
Sign in & account access
Validation
INS-AUTH-01 an empty form is not submitted and both fields show an error
INS-AUTH-01b empty fields say "is required" (BUG-001: the last rule's message wins)
INS-AUTH-02 rejects a malformed email and a password that breaks the rules
Phone sign-in
INS-AUTH-03 phone mode has the fixed +966 field and validates the number
Password field
INS-AUTH-04 the eye icon shows and hides the password
Wrong credentials
INS-AUTH-05 a wrong password keeps you on Sign in with an error
Forgot password
INS-AUTH-06 Forgot Password opens the reset screen in the selected mode
Environment switcher
INS-AUTH-07 the environment switcher closes on Cancel
Email sign-in
INS-AUTH-08 signs in with email and password and lands on Home @smoke
Session
INS-AUTH-09 the session survives an app relaunch
Sign out
INS-AUTH-10 Log out asks first; Cancel keeps you signed in
INS-AUTH-11 Log out signs you out
Remember me
INS-AUTH-12 Remember me fills in the email next time
Invitation link
INS-AUTH-13 an invite link while signed in asks to log out first; Cancel keeps the session
INS-AUTH-14 an invite link with a malformed token shows the link error screen
Verification code
INS-AUTH-15 the code screen shows the email and a countdown, and refuses a wrong code
Profile and settings
Profile menu
INS-PROF-01 Profile shows your name, email and the menu for your account type
Personal information
INS-PROF-02 Personal information shows name, gender, date of birth, phone and email
INS-PROF-03 the gender dropdown offers Male, Female and Other
INS-PROF-04 editing the first name saves ("Profile updated successfully!") and shows on Profile; then restored
Change email
INS-PROF-05 Email Edit opens the change-email sheet
Address
INS-PROF-06 Address shows its fields; an empty city is refused with "City is required"
INS-PROF-07 Street address suggests places as you type
Login & security
INS-PROF-08 Login & security validates the form before saving
INS-PROF-09 a wrong old password is refused by the server
Languages & currency
INS-PROF-10 Languages & currency opens both pickers and saves
Theme
INS-PROF-11 Theme switches between System default, Light and Dark
Messages entry
INS-PROF-12 Messages in the menu opens the inbox
Notifications
Preferences
INS-PROF-13 Notifications lists a switch per notification type
INS-PROF-14 a notification switch turns off and back on
Inbox
INS-NOTIF-01 the bell opens Notifications with a count and Mark All Read
Mark all read
INS-NOTIF-02 Mark All Read clears the unread badge
Open a notification
INS-NOTIF-03 tapping a notification opens what it is about
Support
Support & Legal
INS-PROF-15 Support & Legal holds Terms of Service, FAQ and Support Center
Terms of Service
INS-PROF-16 Terms of Service opens and scrolls
FAQ
INS-PROF-17 FAQ questions open to show the answer and close again
Support Centre
INS-SUP-01 Profile › Support & Legal › Support Center opens the Support Centre with All / Open / Closed
Filter tickets
INS-SUP-02 Open and Closed tabs filter the tickets by status
Create a ticket
INS-SUP-03 a new ticket cannot be submitted until title, category and description are valid
INS-SUP-04 Category offers Accounts & Billing, Technical Support, General Issue and Property Issue
INS-SUP-06 a valid ticket submits and shows "Ticket Submitted Successfully"
INS-SUP-07 Back To Support lists the new ticket
INS-SUP-13 Cancel on a new ticket goes back without creating one
INS-SUP-14 Back To Home on the success screen returns Home
Attachments
INS-SUP-05 a photo can be attached from Browse Files
Search tickets
INS-SUP-08 search by title finds the ticket (BUG-008: the API searches ticket IDs only)
INS-SUP-08b search by ticket ID finds the ticket; a search with no match says so
Follow a ticket
INS-SUP-09 the ticket opens titled with its ID and says it awaits the support team
INS-SUP-10 you can add a message to an open ticket
INS-SUP-11 the info button shows the ticket details
Closed ticket
INS-SUP-12 a closed ticket says it is closed and has no message box
Messages
Inbox
INS-MSG-01 the Messages tab shows the inbox with Search by name
Search
INS-MSG-02 a search with no match says "No conversations match your search."
INS-MSG-03 search by the participant's name finds the conversation
Send a message
INS-MSG-04 sending a message shows it in the conversation straight away
INS-MSG-06 Send stays off for an empty message
Contact details blocked
INS-MSG-05 a message with a phone number or email is not sent
Attachments
INS-MSG-07 the attach button offers gallery, camera and document
Delete a conversation
INS-MSG-08 Delete chat asks to confirm; Cancel keeps the conversation
Explore
Map
INS-EXP-01 Explore shows the map with your name, search and the bell
Search area
INS-EXP-02 search area suggests places; choosing one moves the map there
INS-EXP-03 Use my current location is offered and works
INS-EXP-04 × clears the search and the back arrow leaves search
Property details
Summary
INS-PROP-01 shows the summary: type and city, name, requested date, beds, bathrooms, guests @smoke
Photo gallery
INS-PROP-02 the photo counter reads position/total
Description
INS-PROP-03 Show More expands the description and Show Less collapses it
Host
INS-PROP-04 the host section lists the host details and Message host
Location
INS-PROP-05 Location shows the address with View Direction
Amenities
INS-PROP-06-amenities Amenities expands and collapses
Property rules
INS-PROP-06-rules Property rules expands and collapses
Safety details
INS-PROP-06-safety Safety details expands and collapses
Actions
INS-PROP-07 the bottom button matches the status (manual table 5.2)
Navigation
INS-PROP-08 Back returns to Home
Message host
INS-PROP-09 Message host opens a conversation with the host
Get to the property
Map View
INS-MAP-01 the map pin on a card opens Map View with the trip summary and Google Maps
INS-MAP-07 Back returns to Home
INS-MAP-08 Map View on Property Details opens the same map
Trip summary
INS-MAP-02 the trip summary shows the distance to the property (straight line when no route)
Map controls
INS-MAP-03 my-location and zoom controls respond
Arrival
INS-MAP-04 I’ve Arrived asks to confirm and warns how far away you are; Cancel closes
INS-MAP-05 Yes, I’ve arrived shows "You have arrived at the location!" with Start
INS-MAP-06 closing the arrival panel keeps you arrived: Start replaces I’ve Arrived
Accept or reject a request
Reject sheet
INS-REQ-01 Reject opens "Reason for rejecting?"; Submit stays off under 5 characters
INS-REQ-02 the reason is capped at 250 characters
INS-REQ-03 Cancel closes the sheet and keeps the request Pending
Accept
INS-REQ-04 ✓ accepts a Pending request: "Inspection accepted", the card gets Start and map @mutating @smoke
INS-REQ-04b the accepted card reads "Accepted" (BUG-009: it reads Assigned)
Reject
INS-REQ-05 ✕ rejects a Pending request with a reason: it moves to Unassigned @mutating
INS-REQ-06 the arrow button in the sheet header submits the rejection too @mutating
Home
Header
INS-HOME-01 header shows your name, the greeting for this hour, search and the bell @smoke
INS-HOME-11 the bell opens Notifications
Filters
INS-HOME-02 every status filter chip is there and All is selected by default
INS-HOME-03-Pending the Pending chip lists only Pending requests
INS-HOME-03-Assigned the Assigned chip lists only Assigned requests
INS-HOME-03-Unassigned the Unassigned chip lists only Unassigned requests
INS-HOME-03-InProgress the InProgress chip lists only InProgress requests
INS-HOME-03-Completed the Completed chip lists only Completed requests
Refresh
INS-HOME-04 pull to refresh resets the filter to All
Search
INS-HOME-05 search finds a request by its property name; × clears it
INS-HOME-06 a search with no match says so; the header × closes search
Request card
INS-HOME-07 each card shows status, inspection type, title and subtitle
INS-HOME-08 card buttons match the status (manual table 3.5)
INS-HOME-09 tapping a card (not a button) opens Property Details

INS-HOME-10 the in-progress card opens the list of inspections underway
